title: Automated Safety Analysis for Agentic Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.28469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM applications are increasingly built as agentic workflows: programs that combine model calls, external tools, and control logic to act autonomously on a user's behalf. Because these workflows execute real-world actions, logical flaws in how a workflow is wired can cause severe harm in deployed systems. Unlike prompt injections or malformed API calls, these workflow bugs stem from defects in the workflow's design, yet no existing tool can statically validate workflow logic across frameworks prior to deployment. We present Apsis, a static safety analyzer that detects workflow bugs before deployment. To operate across frameworks, Apsis lifts framework-specific code into a common intermediate representation (IR). This IR models a workflow as a semantic graph of steps, data dependencies, and shared state, while annotating each component with behavioral properties such as whether an input is mandatory or how a shared channel merges concur

translated_title: 智能体工作流的自动化安全分析
translated_abstract: LLM应用正日益以智能体工作流的形式构建：这类程序将模型调用、外部工具和控制逻辑相结合，能够代表用户自主执行操作。由于这些工作流会执行真实世界中的动作，工作流连接方式中的逻辑缺陷可能在部署后的系统中造成严重危害。与提示注入或格式错误的API调用不同，这类工作流缺陷源于工作流设计本身的缺陷，然而目前尚无工具能够在部署前静态地验证跨框架的工作流逻辑。我们提出了Apsis，一个能够在部署前检测工作流缺陷的静态安全分析器。为了实现跨框架运行，Apsis将框架特定的代码提升为一种统一的中间表示（IR）。该IR将工作流建模为由步骤、数据依赖和共享状态构成的语义图，并为每个组件标注行为属性，例如某个输入是否为必需项，或共享通道如何合并并发的写入。
tldr: 该论文提出了Apsis，一个部署前的静态安全分析器，它通过将不同框架的智能体工作流代码提升为统一的语义图中间表示，从而在部署前自动检测工作流设计层面的逻辑缺陷。
en_tdlr: Apsis is a static safety analyzer that detects design-level workflow bugs before deployment by lifting framework-specific agentic workflow code into a unified intermediate representation modeled as a semantic graph of steps, data dependencies, and shared state.
